diagnosisOfTheFailedWalk.claim: PROBE STEERING DEFECT — NOT a game restore failure.
diagnosisOfTheFailedWalk.mechanism: walkTowards calibrated each key on [dx, dz] only and rejected any key whose XZ magnitude was <= 0.05. On the +X face the A/D keys move the body predominantly in world Y, so both were recorded null and the walk retained no lateral control. Distance and key choice were likewise XZ-only, and the target's +Y-face y=51.05 was invisible to the steering.
diagnosisOfTheFailedWalk.notInferred: No conclusion about whether the game restored the pose correctly is drawn from this walk failure.

unresolvedObservationGaps.detail: EfficientScene.tsx's saved-pose validation/fallback branch (resumeIsSafe vs findValidSpawnSite vs arrivalPose.playerSurfacePosition) publishes no marker and is NOT observable from outside. The probe can only measure the RESULTING position and classify it as resumed-at-saved-pose / resumed-at-arrival-fallback / resumed-at-neither. No source change is proposed to close this.

arrivalPose.playerSurfacePosition is not exposed to the probe, so spawnVsSavedPose.arrivalFallbackPose will be null and the 'resumed-at-arrival-fallback' classification cannot be confirmed on this run.

Neither CommonGroundProbeSnapshot nor pageReadState publishes a physics ground-contact flag. footingReading will report physicsGrounded=null / physicsGroundedAvailable=false. Audit-plane `supported` is reported separately and false there is not a broken-physics claim.

CDP DOMStorage attachment has NOT been exercised against a live browser in this CPU-only preparation. If it fails at runtime, the probe records available=false plus the error and the save-write vs early-overwrite ordering stays unobserved; no fallback is used.

earned-1 recorded no usable A/D displacement on the +X face, so the CPU case for that geometry uses a synthetic 2.23-unit +Y displacement. Whether the shipped controls actually move the body laterally on that face is an OPEN RUNTIME QUESTION, and EC3D-LATERAL-KEYS-DEAD exists to record a negative answer honestly rather than read it as an obstacle.
